title: Money Basics and Budgeting
learningGoals: Understand how to use an ATM safely
Distinguish between essential needs and flexible wants

teachingScript.teacherLine: Welcome to MoneyMind! Today, we are going to start your journey into financial literacy. First, let's look at what the Bangalore Math Championship taught us about value.

data.title: Your Financial Journey Begins
data.headline: Welcome to MoneyMind!
data.challenge: By the end of this session, you will earn your first virtual ₹500 for your wallet!

teachingScript.teacherLine: To spend money, we often need to get it from a bank. An ATM or Automated Teller Machine is like a magic box that gives you your money even when the bank is closed.
Now that you have some cash, you need to decide how to spend it. In personal finance, we distinguish between Needs (things you MUST have) and Wants (things that are NICE to have).

data.title: The Golden Rule: Needs vs Wants
data.takeaway: Always pay for your Needs before your Wants!

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's practice! You have ₹1000. Try to pick items that are mostly needs while staying within your budget.

questionPool.questionText: What is the primary purpose of money?
questionPool.hint: It's used to swap for goods and services.

questionPool.questionText: A machine used to withdraw cash from a bank account is called an _____.
Is a 'New PlayStation' a Need or a Want?
questionPool.hint: Do you need it to survive or go to school?
